stem: Which maintenance note is most useful?
choices: “Pump P-12, Zone 3, alarm at 14:10; tank level normal, no visible leak, zone received no flow; supervisor and maintenance notified.”
rationale: A useful maintenance note identifies the exact asset and location, when the problem occurred, what was observed, which operator-level checks were completed, the operational impact, and who was notified. Vague labels like “broken” or “urgent” do not give maintenance enough evidence to begin efficiently.
